primary_comparison: New-minus-old NASM command wall-time median with default storage
secondary_comparison: The same image comparison with ReFS storage; per-label and resource summaries
assignment: 32 shuffled balanced blocks, each with both labels and both storage modes
top_up: At most one additional balanced 128-job batch if an image/storage cell has fewer than 25 successes and both image versions are still appearing. This is a sample-count rule, not a significance rule.
interval: 95% percentile bootstrap intervals, 10000 resamples of complete scheduling blocks identified by run ID and block number
report: All exclusions and failures, image/storage/label counts, medians, p10/p90, absolute and relative image effects, phase decomposition, whole-machine resource deltas
limitations: Runner images cannot be pinned by label and are not randomly assigned by the experiment
Image associations are not causal proof of a specific image component or bottleneck
Whole-machine counters include background Windows activity
Instrumentation and output filtering differ from the uninstrumented production step
Do not pool cache-hit and cache-miss release-build timings into this NASM-only experiment
Eight instrumentation canaries are excluded from the confirmatory comparison
